title: "Aakriti's Animint Gallery"
output: 
  html_document:
    self_contained: false
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat('<table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Screenshot</th><th>Project</th><th>Links</th></tr></thead><tbody>')

for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  repo_path <- gsub("[[:space:]]", "", dt$viz_owner_repo[i])
  repo_only <- gsub("aakritixyz/", "", repo_path)
  
  # Using 'H-T-T-P-S' to keep Pandoc from recognizing it as a link
  img_url <- paste0("HTTPS-FIX://aakritixyz.github.io/", repo_only, "/Capture.PNG")
  demo_url <- paste0("HTTPS-FIX://aakritixyz.github.io/", repo_only, "/")

  cat('<tr>')
  # We provide a dummy src so the element is 'real' to the browser
  cat(sprintf('<td><img class="gallery-img" src="about:blank" data-url="%s" width="250" style="border:1px solid #eee;"></td>', img_url))
  cat(sprintf('<td><b>%s</b></td>', dt$title[i]))
  cat(sprintf('<td><a class="gallery-link" href="#" data-href="%s">Interactive Demo</a><br><a href="%s">Source</a></td>', demo_url, dt$source[i]))
  cat('</tr>')
}
cat('</tbody></table>')
